checkedAlternates.risk: Orion sits right next to Taurus and Gemini.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The ecliptic does not pass through Orion, so Orion is not a zodiac constellation (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Crux is a famous bright constellation.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Crux is the iconic South Circumpolar constellation (group-1), invisible from mid-northern latitudes.
